info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Transaction Push Deletion API
info.description: The Account Transaction Push Deletion API allows consumers to remove specific transaction push notifications related to a customer's account. This endpoint is essential for managing the notifications that customers receive, ensuring they only get relevant updates. Typical use cases include applications that require user-initiated preferences on transaction alerts. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance user experience by providing control over transaction related notifications.

delete.summary: Remove transaction push notifications for a specific account.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete transaction push notifications for the specified account associated with the customer. Use this endpoint to manage notifications effectively and ensure that only relevant alerts are sent.

requestBody.description: The request body for deleting a transaction push associated with a specific account. Ensure that the necessary information is provided to successfully process the deletion.
